import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    cnt = [0] * 10005
    for _ in range(n):
        x = next(it)
        cnt[x] += 1
    k = next(it)
    # Compute prefix sums for indices 0..3000 (inclusive)
    for i in range(1, 3001):
        cnt[i] += cnt[i - 1]
    ans = 0
    for s in range(1, 5000 - k + 1):
        val = cnt[s + k] - cnt[s - 1]
        if val > ans:
            ans = val
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
